findings.desc: Framework doc still says Quantum is a future design contract, not a delivered runtime implementation, but B-5118 registers a read-only quantum ClaimAdmissibilityPack by default through QUANTUM_CLAIM_ADMISSIBILITY_PACK and DEFAULT_CLAIM_ADMISSIBILITY_PACKS. Update wording to distinguish full future pack/gate integration from the now-implemented M2 read-only descriptor and normalization pack.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed doc/code drift by updating claim-admissibility-adapter-pack-framework.md to state Quantum M2 read-only descriptor/normalization pack is implemented and default-registered while full gate policy, benchmarks, reporting/governance, production, Authority, hardware, and theory claims remain pending/non-goals. Verified by npm --prefix packages/main run test:quantum-claim-admissibility and full lattice validate PASS.

findings.desc: Quantum pack read-only descriptors are only shallow-frozen: QUANTUM_CLAIM_IDS and QUANTUM_EVIDENCE_KINDS are exported as const arrays in quantum.ts lines 13-29, then reused directly as claimIds and artifactKinds in pack-framework.ts lines 454 and 470. freezeItems at pack-framework.ts lines 218-220 freezes only the schema object and containing array, not those nested arrays, so consumers can mutate listClaimAdmissibilityPacks()[quantum].claimSchemas[0].claimIds or evidenceSchemas[0].artifactKinds at runtime despite the read-only/declarative boundary. Freeze or defensive-copy these nested arrays before exposing the pack descriptor.
